title: Absolute Beginner Ballet Class 1 || Online Ballet Lesson

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher is encouraging and emphasizes that ballet is accessible to everyone, regardless of their natural body type. She breaks down complex movements into simple, manageable steps, focusing on proper technique and body alignment.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces herself and the class.
The teacher demonstrates a warm-up combination.
The teacher explains the importance of pliés and introduces the three basic foot positions.

metaphors: second is just an opened first
safety: keep weight evenly distributed on the foot

steps_taught.name: half-toe, full-toe
steps_taught.description: A sequence of rising onto the balls of the feet and then the toes.

steps_taught.name: pedals
steps_taught.description: Alternating heel lifts while keeping the toes on the floor.

steps_taught.name: elevés
steps_taught.description: Rising onto the balls of the feet with both feet together.

steps_taught.name: first position
steps_taught.description: Feet in a V shape with heels together.

steps_taught.name: second position
steps_taught.description: Feet in an open V shape.

steps_taught.name: fifth position
steps_taught.description: One heel in front of the other toe.

what_works: The teacher's clear, step-by-step instructions and her emphasis on not worrying about perfection make the lesson easy to follow.
what_hinders: The lack of varied camera angles might make it difficult to see the foot positions clearly.

quotes.text: I will teach you to work with what you do have.
Don't worry too much about memorizing what the combination is for now.
Pliés are really, really fundamental to ballet.
Most of us actually aren't able to do that.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of the camera and speaks directly to the viewer.
The teacher demonstrates the half-toe, full-toe sequence.
The teacher demonstrates the pedal movement.
The teacher demonstrates the elevé movement.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher explicitly encourages students to work with their current physical limitations rather than striving for an idealized ballet body.
